visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A vibrantly colored dish of stir-fried green peppers with small dried fish and tofu is presented on a white plate. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the crispy fish and the glossy peppers. A logo watermark and various text overlays appear at the top and center of the frame. (2) Close-up shots show hands holding a small ceramic dish with fermented black beans, which are then poured into a metal bowl. Subsequently, a larger bowl of dried small fish is shown and then emptied into a metal strainer under a faucet for rinsing. The background is a well-organized, brightly lit modern kitchen. (3) The scene shifts to intensive ingredient preparation. Hands use a sharp knife to slice green peppers, white tofu strips, and red chilies on a wooden cutting board. Garlic is crushed and minced, while green onions are smashed and cut into segments. Every action is captured in clear, close-up detail against the neutral tones of the kitchen counter. (4) Dried fish are placed on a plate lined with paper towels to be dabbed dry. Then, clear oil is poured from a pink bottle into a black pan on a red-rimmed induction stove. The dried fish are added and stir-fried until they become crispy and golden, with steam rising from the pan. (5) The fried fish are filtered through a mesh strainer into a bowl, and the oil is poured back into the pan. Tofu slices are added to the hot oil and fried until they reach a slightly browned, firm texture. The hands use a black spatula to toss the tofu pieces continuously for even cooking. (6) Aromatics including the chopped black beans, garlic, green onion whites, and red chili slices are added to the pan with a fresh pour of oil. They are sautéed until fragrant. Then, a large heap of sliced green peppers is added to the pan, and a wooden spoon is used to toss them thoroughly. (7) The previously fried fish and tofu are reintroduced to the pan. Seasonings like sugar and pepper are sprinkled in, followed by the pouring of a dark sauce mixture from a white bowl. A final splash of rice wine is added as the ingredients are tossed vigorously one last time, creating a steamy, appetizing mixture. (8) The finished stir-fry is scooped out of the pan and arranged neatly on a white, leaf-shaped plate. The camera provides a close-up of the final presentation, showing the diverse textures of the ingredients under warm kitchen lighting. (9) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a pink apron over a grey top, enters the frame. She uses chopsticks to pick up a portion of the food and tastes it with a joyful expression. She nods in approval, gives a thumbs-up, and uses a heart hand gesture while text and social media handles appear around her.

The background music maintains a constant rhythm with soft percussion and strumming guitars. (3) Rhythmic, percussive chopping sounds dominate as a knife strikes a wooden surface repeatedly. Each stroke is sharp and distinct, emphasizing a fast-paced preparation process. The narrator’s voice stays enunciated and upbeat throughout the sequence. (4) A loud, continuous sizzle begins as fish hits hot oil. The intensity of the white noise from the frying increases. This is punctuated by metallic clinking and scraping sounds of a wooden spoon against the pan. (5) Bubbling and popping sounds of hot oil continue as tofu is fried. The narrator explains the texture changes, her pitch rising slightly to convey enthusiasm. The music remains a consistent uplifting bed underneath the cooking sounds. (6) Sudden splashing sounds of liquids occur as soy sauce and rice wine are poured into the pan. This causes a temporary surge in sizzling intensity. The narration continues with high articulation clarity, guiding the viewer through the final steps. (7) Chopsticks clinking against a plate and soft mouth-related tasting sounds are audible at the very end. The female voice expresses deep satisfaction with an audible 'Mmm' sound, concluding with a warm sign-off as the music fades.
